description: Resolve labels to the numeric codes or exact alphanumeric item identities faostat_query_observations needs: areas (countries/regions), items (commodities), and elements (metrics). Use query for full-text matching, name_contains for substring matching, code or code_text for exact identity, or omit them to list. Item and element matches occur in the selected domain; areas use shared vocabulary. For elements, optionally pass item_codes or item_codes_text to discover metrics and distinct units observed for those items; this does not establish area/year/source coverage. Empty item selectors match nothing. Page with offset and limit using nextOffset when truncated. Areas carry country/aggregate classification. Verified domain-specific item groups carry aggregate; null means unclassified, not safe-to-sum. Item groups can overlap their members even with matching units. Area aggregates include codes ≥ 5000 and curated roll-ups such as China=351; exclude overlapping regional and country rows when summing.

code.description: Exact code lookup. Takes precedence over `query`/`name_contains` when provided.

code_text.description: Exact alphanumeric item code. Only for dimension item; mutually exclusive with code. Numeric identities use code.

domain.description: FAOSTAT domain code (e.g. "QCL"). Item and element resolution is scoped to the codes present in this domain's data; area code lists are shared across all indexed domains.

item_codes.description: For element resolution only: restrict elements and units to these items. Empty matches nothing; omit for domain-wide elements. Mutually exclusive with item_codes_text.

item_codes_text.description: For element resolution only: restrict elements and units to these exact text items. Empty matches nothing; mutually exclusive with item_codes.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over the label. Used only when `query` is omitted.

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset into the match set. When the response reports truncated, pass the returned nextOffset here to fetch the next page. Ignored for exact-code lookups (always single-page).

query.description: Full-text search term, FTS5-matched against the dimension labels with prefix matching (e.g. "wheat", "import quantity"). Relevance-ranked.

name: faostat_resolve_codes

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_item_scope`: Item selectors are combined or supplied outside element resolution. `invalid_text_selector`: code_text is supplied with code or outside the item dimension. `unknown_domain`: The domain code is not a selected (indexed) FAOSTAT domain. `index_not_ready`: The shared dimension tables are empty, or the selected item/element domain requires an initial sync or an ingest upgrade. `query_timeout`: The item or element lookup's mirror read — time queued behind other calls' reads plus execution — ran past the 45-second per-call ceiling. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matches.description: Matching codes, relevance-ranked for query mode, else by code.

code.description: Numeric code for faostat_query_observations; null for alphanumeric items carried by code_text.

code_text.description: Exact alphanumeric item identity for item_codes_text; null for numeric codes.

cpc_code.description: CPC crosswalk code for items (apostrophe stripped), when available.

kind.description: For areas: country or aggregate region. For items: aggregate only for verified domain-specific groups; null means unclassified, never safe-to-sum. Null for elements.

units.description: Element matches only: distinct non-null units observed in the selected domain and item scope. Empty means no specified units.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass on the next call to fetch the following page. Present only when truncated is true; absent on the last page and for exact-code lookups.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, more pages remain, or the dimension is not yet indexed.

totalMatches.description: Total matches in this domain before the result cap.

truncated.description: True when more matches remain beyond the returned page — fetch them with nextOffset.
